name: Statement lights up
look: One large statement rests at half ink (readable, about 4 to 1) and turns to ink word by word as it crosses the middle of the screen, a strong word to the accent; it runs back on the way up.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop (one paragraph's colours); under reduced motion the whole statement is in ink, the accent word in the accent.

needs.words: one paragraph of 25 to 60 words (never under 12) in a section sized to it (data-screen="band")
